entities.summary: The Jameh Mosque of Jahrom is a Friday mosque, located adjacent to the Jahrom Bazaar, in the old Sinan neighborhood of Jahrom, in the province of Fars, Iran. The mosque was built during the Seljuq era in the 11th-12th centuries, and completed in 1673 CE.
